'''Naris Pelden''' is a tirewoman in the [[Royal Palace of Andor]]. Her sister is named [[Sephanie Pelden|Sephanie]].

==Appearance==
Naris is a shy, stocky woman with a square face.

==Activities==
[[Essande]] hires Naris and her Sephanie when [[Elayne Trakand]] comes to [[Caemlyn]], as they are unlikely to be spies.{{ref/book|10|12}} All three of the women help both Elayne and [[Aviendha]] bathe and dress.{{ref/book|10|13}}{{ref/book|11|15}}

Naris is happy to be a ladies' maid, rather than cleaning the halls. 

She is as awed of Essande as she is of Elayne. She was also awed by the Aiel Wise Ones.

She was reluctant to leave Elayne's rooms when the palace started rearranging itself due to weaknesses in the Pattern, but she did her job anyway.
